notes:
# Bugfixes
* Fixed a bug in Reforge where the AH Buy feature would be displayed even if the user was in an area with no AH access.
* Fixed a bug in Reforge where the user had a required ingredient but was in an unreachable bag not correctly displaying an orange box.
* Fixed a bug in Reforge where the queue could sometimes hang when adding new reforge items while it was already in progress.
* Fixed a bug where the Use Dark Matter setting in Geas Fete Augmentation would be unable to be set to 0. Now turned into a full toggle on/off setting.
* Fixed a bug where Item tooltips would render off the screen in some scenarios where the app was maximized to fullscreen.
